title: Opening chatter and microphone set-up at Chris Brubeck's house

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.

Interviewees: Dave Brubeck (December 6, 1920 – December 5, 2012) with Russell Gloyd and Iola Brubeck (August 14, 1923 – March 12, Interviewers: Ted Gioia with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 90 pp.

Track markers were accidentally embedded into the original recording in such a way as to lose a few words at the breaks. Square brackets and five spaces – [ ] – indicate these small gaps in the transcription.
There’s two cats in this house, and I don’t mean jazz musicians. But I haven’t heard them or seen them, so they probably are hiding.

This is a new house that – Chris had a house on the other side of town and got a pretty good deal and was able to have room for the first time in his life for a studio. He’s been writing so much – always new things.
It’s important to have the right setting.
